technical.summary: ABBV shows long-term uptrend structure (50/200 EMA bullish) but lacks near-term momentum; short-term death cross, bearish price positioning relative to 9/21 EMAs, and absence of triggered strategies indicate weak swing entry probability despite rising RSI momentum.

fundamental.summary: ABBV shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 90 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Mixed congressional activity (2 small purchases, 1 small sale by junior members) with neutral market sentiment and no recent news data provides insufficient conviction for directional bias.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (151.4) indicates extreme market stress; earnings in 90 days adds event risk but not imminent.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term uptrend structure (50/200 EMA bullish, ADX bullish) with price near support (131.17) offers potential mean-reversion entry if short-term weakness reverses.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 151.4), short-term death cross, price below all short-term MAs, no triggered strategies, zero smart money conviction, and weak fundamental/sentiment scores create unacceptable risk-reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Long-term uptrend structure (50/200 EMA bullish) and price near support (131.17) offer technical setup, but macro environment (VIX crisis 151.4, inverted yield curve) and short-term bearish signals (death cross, price below all short-term MAs) create unacceptable risk-reward.
decision.primary_risk: Severe macro headwinds and VIX crisis levels create systemic downside risk that overwhelms technical support; short-term momentum collapse suggests further weakness before reversal.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding 19 Health Care positions with existing ABBV exposure; sector concentration and macro stress warrant avoiding additional capital deployment in this ticker.
